name: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti
notes: Launch article states 3584 CUDA cores and 11 GB GDDR5X at 11 Gbps, and nothing else numeric. Bus width, bandwidth and board power are therefore null here rather than copied from a spec-aggregator. 11 GB holds a 7B Q4 with tight KV headroom and does not hold a 13B Q4. No tensor cores.
